title: Spyglass: Now Available to Everyone
summary: We're excited to announce that the powerful Spyglass tool has officially moved out of beta and is now ready for all users to experience its enhanced capabilities.

title: Advanced File Management for Your Editor
summary: Gain complete control over your content with new features that let you effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the display of your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: See What's Next: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: Our brand new public roadmap provides a clear, real-time view of our past achievements, current priorities, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Experience a refined task management experience with our enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to drag, and beautifully integrated into the interface.

title: Enhanced Collaborative Editing
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and transparent co-editing experience, making real-time collaboration with your team simpler and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Easier Collaboration on Shared Content
summary: Easily discover and collaborate on all relevant items shared with you, fostering a more connected and productive workspace.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language with our new comprehensive international language support, connecting users across the globe.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and transparency over its development.

title: Intelligent Knowledge Network
summary: Effortlessly explore and organize your entire knowledge base with dynamic filtering and powerful new workflow integrations.

title: Enhanced Search: Pinpoint Information and Create Custom Collections
summary: Discover a revolutionary way to navigate your knowledge base, utilizing advanced search filters to precisely locate information and save your tailored results as personalized Compendiums for quick reference.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Unlock more intuitive and interactive note-taking with dynamic new ways to organize, visualize, and engage with your connected ideas.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting & Premium Plans Arrive
summary: Prepare to take full control of your data with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting capabilities and unlock powerful new features through our flexible premium and enterprise plans.

title: Revamped Themes and Exciting New Options
summary: Prepare for a visual upgrade as we refine our existing themes and unveil a selection of exciting new styles to perfectly match your preferences.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're enhancing our homepage greetings to always match the accurate time of day, ensuring a more personalized and welcoming experience for you.

title: Streamlined Tag Organization & Bulk Actions
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new bulk actions, allowing you to unapply tags and organize ideas, quests, and sources directly from the tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: We're expanding our supported content types to include popular formats like YouTube videos, websites, and text, so you can effortlessly incorporate all your valuable information into your workflow.
